run_superglue_multi_task: run the SuperglueTeacher to train on boolq, cb, and copa tasks together
create_boolq_teacher: create a BoolqTeacher instance to load the SuperGLUE boolq passage and question dataset
create_cb_teacher: create a CbTeacher instance to load the SuperGLUE commitment bank premise and hypothesis dataset
create_copa_teacher: create a CopaTeacher instance to load the SuperGLUE choice of plausible alternatives dataset
create_axb_teacher: create an AxbTeacher instance to load the SuperGLUE AXB evaluation sentence pair dataset
